description: For a project in front of a model API: limit which models one app may ask for (the request body's "model", or a /models/<name> path). Other models are refused with 403 model_not_allowed before the provider sees them. models: null removes the limit.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

models.description: Exact names or prefixes ending in *; null for no limit

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

name: gate_set_models
title: Set an app's allowed models
